text: "Their young ones become strong, they grow up in the open field; They leave and do not return to them.
"Will you have faith and depend on him to return your grain And gather it from your threshing floor?
"Yet when she lifts herself on high, [So swift is she that] she laughs at the horse and his rider.
"As often as the trumpet sounds he says, 'Aha!' And he smells the battle from far away, And senses the thunder of the captains and the war cry.
"His young ones suck up blood; And where the slain are, there is he."
